  RootPackage
  class IntGate(var waiter: Continuation<Int>?)
    fun complete
  class BooleanGate(var waiter: Continuation<Boolean>?)
    fun complete
  class IntRegistration(val gate: IntGate), SuspendRegistration<Int>
    public fun register
  class BooleanRegistration(val gate: BooleanGate), SuspendRegistration<Boolean>
    public fun register
  suspend fun waitForInt(gate: IntGate): Int
    =
      Call suspendCoroutine
        Call IntRegistration
          Var gate
  suspend fun waitForBoolean(gate: BooleanGate): Boolean
    =
      Call suspendCoroutine
        Call BooleanRegistration
          Var gate
  class MultipleTask(val firstGate: IntGate, val secondGate: IntGate, val booleanGate: BooleanGate), SuspendTask<Int>
    public suspend fun run
  class RecordingCompletion(), Continuation<Int>
    public fun resume
    public fun resumeWithException
  fun main()
    val first
      Call IntGate
        Var None
    val second
      Call IntGate
        Var None
    val accepted
      Call BooleanGate
        Var None
    Call startCoroutine
      Call MultipleTask
        Var first
        Var second
        Var accepted
      Call RecordingCompletion
    Call println
      StringLiteral "started"
    MethodCall complete
      Var first
      IntLiteral 20
    Call println
      StringLiteral "first"
    MethodCall complete
      Var second
      IntLiteral 21
    Call println
      StringLiteral "second"
    MethodCall complete
      Var accepted
      BoolLiteral true
